SectionObject.Title: Energy labels of buildings
SectionObject.Text1: This data set shows the energy labels of buildings. The labels A-G are based on the energy use requirements imposed on new buildings that are being built today.

SectionObject.Title: Energy demand per unit area
SectionObject.Text1: This data set shows the hotspots of annual (primary) energy demand for heating and electricity in buildings.Based on a computational energy model for the year 2020.

SectionObject.Title: Hours of sunshine,Summer
SectionObject.Text1:
This data set shows the number of hours of sunshine for the longest(summer solstice 21/6) day of the year. 
The visualisation begins just before sunrise and ends shortly after sunset.
SectionObject.Text2: Visualization Linköpings Universitet, Datageneration DTCC, Chalmers

SectionObject.Title: Hours of sunshine,Winter
SectionObject.Text1:
This data set shows the number of hours of sunshine for the shortest(winter solstice 21/12) day of the year. 
The visualisation begins just before sunrise and ends shortly after sunset.
SectionObject.Text2: Visualization Linköpings Universitet, Datageneration DTCC, Chalmers
